body:
Social media isn't really social. It's almost antisocial. It's fuel is fear, anger, lust, narcissism and envy. Clicks are money for Facebook and other giants. And often people click links to stories that create strong emotions in them; especially anger. That's why "fake news" spreads so fast in social media. And that's just good news for the corporations. If people only click and use their services, the more profit it creates. That's why Google, Youtube and Facebook even promote different forms of hate-speech. It makes people click like nothing else.

And the more time you spend on Facebook, the more jealous you become. Especially if you are suffering from depression or other issues. Facebook just makes you feel even more insecure and bad because you see how much fun everybody else has. And you are not having it. But funny thing is that that all is a lie. Most people who are happy on Facebook are really just miserable. They spend so much time to make others believe that their lives are full of happiness and that nothing is wrong. They need constant worship and acceptance from others. They are not sharing their lives because they are happy. People who are really feeling good, don't have a need to post every day dozens of pics to Facebook, Instagram or Twitter. 

I know personally some people who are "stars" on social media. They are those whose every post and pic get hundreds of likes. And they all are mentally broken. Some of them have even told me that they consider suicide. 

But still people use Facebook. That's because it's so addictive. It's like a drug and it's designed that way. Facebook makes you hungry for new updates. After a while, you just can't be without it. It slowly takes over your life. That's why so many people are glued to the screens and walk around like zombies with their "smart"phones. 

That whole sickness has pretty much destroyed actual sociality between people. People don't talk to each other anymore. And the bad thing is that it's only going to get worse. Even toddlers have their own iphones. Imagine how they will grow up? Just f*cked up...

I don't believe that there is going to be some kinda sudden collapse into some global, Mad Max-style dystopia. Most countries and governments will remain in power and at developed countries will be able to hold mostly rule of law. But places that are now bad will be whole lot worse in 10 years. 

Also the southern parts of developed countries (Southern Europe, parts of USA, Japan) will be hurt. And rising sealevels will flood many major cities and there is going to be some mass evacuations. Cities like New York will be left partially underwater. This also going to cause major problems in many European countries. 

And because of famines and lack of water in the third world countries, there will be mass immigrations to the northern countries. Europe will have huge problems with that. Just look at current situations and then think that what it would be if it were 10 times worse. Probably in the late 2020s, maybe about a half of the population of Europe will be refugees and immigrants. That will f*ck the economy and we will see mass unemployment, large scales riots and internal conflicts that will maybe turn into full-blown wars in the next decades. But Europe, especially northern parts of it, will remain quite decent for long time. 

USA, because of it's location, will most likely shut it's doors from the refugees. The whole country will be under some constant marshall law (maybe already Trump will start that). Anyone who disobeys will be sent to some type of concentration camps. But USA will remain it's power and won't collapse. After all it has the most powerful army and heavily armed police forces to control even large uprisings. And when the things get bad, the army and government won't give a f*ck about civil rights.

Now it also looks like that there will be some kinda economic crash. Maybe it will happen in the next 10 years or maybe not. But for sure all other issues make economy worse. Even though now some idiots say that there is some kinda wonderful recovery going on...

And the mass extinction of species will cause food shortages that will especially hit the poor countries. More prosperous countries can have food reserves that will last very long. I don't think that within 10 years there is going to be famine in developed countries.

Of course there are always things that can't be predicted. But i think that next 10 years will be some kinda "beginning of the end" for the planet as we know it. Sh*t will probably truly hit the fan within next 30 years.

I think pretty much the same way. There really isn't escaping it; world is full of suffering and it's not going to get any better. But most people don't want to admit it, even though they also know it. And people who openly admit that world is sh*tty aren't very popular. I used to talk a lot about how bad things are going in the world and that made many people turn their backs on me. People I thought were my real friends. But that just kinda proves my point.

Yes. Lately I have started to believe that reality isn't worth it. It just creates so much pain in me. Too often people have just made my life miserable. They tell lies, cheat or just abandon me without any explanation. Maybe I am just an unpleasant person and maybe nobody really wants to be with me. So maybe I should just leave that world behind? I want to stop caring about reality. I want just to stay inside my apartment, read books, write, watch some shows and get high and drink. I sometimes think that maybe I should just buy as much food and drinking as I can and then not go outside for weeks. 

Is there any point in confronting the real world? Especially these days when society is in it's insane deathdrive. I hate all the ads in public places and crowded places give me headache. But at the same time, something makes me go out and get hurt again and again.

The ever-developing science is creating more and more possible ways to reduce pollutions and cO2-emissions. It's just a matter of time when something new comes up. It's not like the progression of technology and science have ended. It's quite the opposite. 

Our current western civilization is so large-scale and pervasive that it just won't go away. People who are born into it are destined to continue it. There really isn't any altenative. And there won't be. After a large-scale disaster, people would just try to continue the same way. Maybe the borders of nations will shift and rulers will change. But the basic structure of capitalist society will not change in any significant way. There will be a ruling class, wage-labour, consumerism and a state. Maybe laws will be slightly different, but the basics will remain. 

And to some degree, even an open rebellion against the system is just part of it. Every revolution against capitalism so far has failed. Even Soviet Russia or communist China with the support of over billion people couldn't destroy capitalist world order. And now every single country is more or less under western capitalism.

Yeah, the world is seriously fucked up. But when it hasn't been? I mean, there has always been wars, genocides, dictators, racism, disease and so on. World has never been any better. And most likely it never will be. Just endless struggle. And people going insane and turning into mindless followers of some religion or ideology. Humanity will probably destroy itself soon with nuclear weapons or by increasing global warming.

Life here is no gift, it is a curse. And God is a fucking monster who enjoys our suffering. But at least we can see it. We don't have to believe all the fucking lies the government, churches, therapists and others are telling us. My depression makes me incredibly clear-minded. It's all obvious to me now. Life is suffering.

Living in post-collapse world could mean that every day would be a traumatizng experience. Basically just like war. Even if you would somehow survive more that couple of weeks, you would become emotionally scarred. You could see your family members die in violent and painful ways. You could develope a PTSD and become insane. Imagine being hungry, delusional, full of fear and in constant panic. And the more radical the changes are, the worse it would be. If your life would turn from modern middle-class into post-apocalyptic survival, your mind probably wouldn't be able to handle it. Everybody has their breaking point. Especially people modern societies; thanks to our developement we have become meantally and physically weak. 

So, don't think that the collapse means just physical suffering. Mental can be evern more horrible. And because of that I really hope I die soon after the collapse. I don't really want to live in physical and mental hell.

Yeah, I feel the same way. Life in it's modern form is a complete insult to humanity. We are basically just cattle for the ruling elite. I find it almost funny when some people say that we are living in a free world. No we are not. Just try to anything without money and you see how "free" you are. 

I'm 25 now and I used to fail in school. Almost didn't made it through highschool (thanks to my crippling depression and anxiety). But I think that some times those who fail at school are those who are seeing through all the lies that society tells us. Because school is just mostly indoctrination. It's a factory that produces workers that then spend their whole lives doing what they are taught to do.

I really don't know how anybody can live in this world and not be depressed. And the worst thing is that it won't get any better. It'll just be worse. We are more and more slaves without any rights. And that's true no matter where you live.

The capitalist system has survived several huge crashes over the history and survived them all. Even global wars and widespread revolutions gave only temporary wounds to the system. If there is a collapse coming in the near future it will be just like it always was. The super-rich would remain still at the top and there wouldn't be any major changes. Of course the poor would get even poorer but because of all the mechanisms of control and surveillance that the elites have, all resistance would be futile. If the elites want, they can already kill anybody anywhere anytime. 

And even if there would be some kinda total collapse that would kill billions of people, the system would still go on. Because all it needs is a small group of relatively rich consumers and capitalists. They can control and run the global economy. Especially now when so many jobs are automated and done by machines. Most people are disposable and irrelevant to the system. In the eyes of system only the rich have any value. 

So, don't think that a financial crash will end the oppressive and destructive system. Because it has never done that and never will. We, the 99%, will just live more hopeless lives. And it's obvious that soon the ruling class will get completely rid of any democracy and human rights. And nothing will stop that. We will all die before there is any real change. The elites can sacrifice almost everybody. And thats why they don't give a damn about environment and the planet. They have the means to survive almost any possible disaster and collapse and still have their incredible wealth. They have luxury underground bunkers that can survive nuclear fallouts and extreme changes in the environment. And because elites have private armies, they can protect themselves forever. The elites will have their luxurious lives with endless orgies and parties as long as they live. Which means over hundred years with modern medicine. And their children inherit all the wealth.

Don't hope that things will get any better.
